name: deepseek_v2_fp8_moe_shuffled_16x16_model_dim6144_n_routed256_inter_dim256
description: sglang's DeepseekV2MoE on one rank, with fp8 experts and the shared expert in their last slot: on hidden_states, each token's topk experts by sigmoid score plus correction_bias, the scores those of the router's logits in hidden_states' dtype (as sglang's MoEGate returns them on ROCm), weighed by the renormalized unbiased scores times routed_scaling_factor, and the shared expert at weight 1, each expert down(silu(gate(x)) * up(x)) of its fp8 weights at a scale per 128 x 128 block, each of its two linears taking its input as the checkpoint's FP8 scheme quantizes it: in bf16, then each 1 x 128 group in fp8 at a scale of its amax / 448; out is their output on this rank, which sglang sums over the ranks.

inter_dim.description: Expert intermediate size on this rank.

n_experts.description: Expert slots: the routed experts, then the shared one.

gate_up_rows.description: w1 rows: gate and up concatenated.

correction_bias.description: Added to the scores to pick experts; never weighs them.

w1.description: Gate-up projection per expert: gate rows, then up rows.

w1_scale.description: w1's dequant scale per 128 x 128 block.

w2_scale.description: w2's dequant scale per 128 x 128 block.

routed_scaling_factor.description: Multiplies the routed weights only: GLM-5's.

out.description: The experts' output on this rank, before sglang's all-reduce sums the ranks'.
